title: What the Plan Hands Back on a Withdrawn Ridgecrest Advantage Application
content:
The premium standing to a member's credit is what the plan is left handing back when an application for a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan is withdrawn before coverage has begun, because a withdrawn application leaves no coverage period at all and nothing was ever owed on it. The money the plan hands back on a withdrawn application is applied first to the rider premium the member still owes on their optional supplemental benefit rider, and only the remainder stands to the member's credit.

### The quantities

- **The premium standing to a member's credit** is the money returned on the application less the rider premium met out of it, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end, and it is never less than nothing.
- **The money returned on the application** is the most recent payment posted to its premium account.
- **The rider premium met out of it** is the rider premium owing taken at the share of it the plan meets, rounded to the nearest cent.
- **The rider premium owing** is the monthly rider premium multiplied by the coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing, rounded to the nearest cent.
- **The monthly rider premium** is nothing.
- **The coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing** are one, that is 1 coverage month.
- **The share of the rider premium owing the plan meets** is none of it, that is 0 per cent of it.

The rider premium owing is rounded to the nearest cent when it is struck, the rider premium met out of the money returned is rounded to the nearest cent when it is taken, and the premium standing to the member's credit is rounded to the nearest cent once at the end.

Only the member, or a representative they have appointed in writing, may withdraw an application, the application is cancelled before it ever takes effect, and the reason recorded is that it was withdrawn before the coverage was due to begin.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take an application whose most recent payment posted to its premium account is 218.40 USD.

- Money returned on the application: 218.40 USD.
- Monthly rider premium: nothing, so 0.00 USD.
- Coverage months of rider premium reckoned as owing: 1.
- Rider premium owing: 0.00 USD multiplied by 1, rounded to the nearest cent, so 0.00 USD.
- Rider premium met out of the money returned: 0.00 USD taken at none of it, so 0.00 USD.
- Premium standing to the member's credit: 218.40 USD less 0.00 USD, rounded once at the end, so **218.40 USD**.
